//: Lighthouse CI budgets (PR-34, measured for the first time and corrected in PR-53). See docs/architecture.md §24 for why this runs against a serving URL rather than inside the PR check, and §36 for the first real numbers and what the two settings below are for.

settings.//formFactor: Throttled mobile, which is what §9's budget is stated against. PR-34 also carried `preset: "desktop"` here — every field it sets is overridden below except the emulated user agent, which it quietly swapped for a desktop one. That one leftover cost two whole audits, so the preset is gone rather than corrected.
settings.//emulatedUserAgent: Lighthouse's own mobile UA plus the `Chrome-Lighthouse` token it used to append itself. Next 15 streams metadata to browsers and inlines it in <head> only for the HTML-limited bots in its own list — which is exactly what the SEO category is a proxy for. Without the token Lighthouse is a browser, gets the streamed copy, and reports `meta-description` as missing on every page of a site whose <head> is correct for every crawler that matters. architecture.md §36.
